Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp

Interface McpSubscriptionBroker

All Superinterfaces:
McpSubscriptions
All Known Implementing Classes:
BasicMcpSubscriptionBroker
public interface McpSubscriptionBroker extends McpSubscriptions
Revision-neutral registry + filtered fan-out publisher for MCP subscriptions/listen.

Extends McpSubscriptions (the publish half) and adds registration/lifecycle: a v2 dispatch branch calls registerIfUnder(int, String, McpSubscriptionFilter) once per accepted subscriptions/listen request. Close (graceful or abrupt) does not flow back through this interface: the returned McpSubscription.close() instead runs a close-callback wired at registration time, which removes the entry directly from the registry the returned handle's key was minted under. unregister(String) is a registry-completeness API for that same by-id removal — it has no current production caller, since the close-callback path never has to look the id back up. Application handlers reach this same instance only through the narrower McpSubscriptions view.

Plain register(String, McpSubscriptionFilter) is uncapped — it never rejects, so a caller wanting an enforced maxConcurrentSubscriptions ceiling must use registerIfUnder(int, String, McpSubscriptionFilter) instead, which admission-checks and mutates the registry as one atomic step. A separate "check activeCount(), then call register" pair is exactly the TOCTOU race this capped variant exists to close: two concurrent callers can both observe a count under the cap and both register before either mutation is visible to the other.

  • Method Details

    • register

      McpSubscription register(String subscriptionId, McpSubscriptionFilter honoredFilter)
      Registers a new subscription and returns its queue handle. Uncapped: never rejects.
      Parameters:
      subscriptionId - The subscription identifier (the listen request's JSON-RPC id). Must not be null or empty.
      honoredFilter - The capability-gated filter this subscription honors. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      The new subscription handle. Never null.

    • registerIfUnder

      Optional<McpSubscription> registerIfUnder(int max, String subscriptionId, McpSubscriptionFilter honoredFilter)
      Atomically admission-checks against max and registers, closing the TOCTOU window a separate activeCount() check plus register(java.lang.String, org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp.McpSubscriptionFilter) call would leave open under concurrent callers (in particular against a JVM-wide shared broker instance, where unrelated callers race each other).

      Re-registering an id that is already present is always allowed and never counted against max, matching register(java.lang.String, org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp.McpSubscriptionFilter)'s replace-on-same-id semantics (the previous subscription with that id is closed) — a replacement does not grow activeCount(), so it cannot be what pushes the registry over the cap.

      Parameters:
      max - The maximum number of concurrently active subscriptions to admit under (exclusive: a request is admitted only while activeCount() is strictly less than this, except for the same-id replacement case above).
      subscriptionId - The subscription identifier (the listen request's JSON-RPC id). Must not be null or empty.
      honoredFilter - The capability-gated filter this subscription honors. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      The new subscription handle, or Optional.empty() if the cap was reached and this was not a same-id replacement.
